split: SHA256(latitude_cell:longitude_cell)%5:0 test,1 tuning,2..4 train; same cell never split
variogram: spherical, fitted using training blocks only; standardized coefficient residual field across origins/destinations
selection: lowest tuning weighted MAE; held-out test reported once, not selected
coefficient_coordinate: five additive log-ratios to sixth destination, clipping p>=1e-8 before transform
locations: first-turn geographical file, no fabricated geocoding; unmapped and exterior use UF fallback
